title: Page modules

sub_fields.label: Anchor ID

sub_fields.instructions: Optional. Lets menus and buttons link here, e.g. "apps" for /#apps. Lowercase, no spaces.

sub_fields.label: Eyebrow
sub_fields.name: eyebrow
sub_fields.instructions: Small spaced caps above the title. Blank = brand name.

sub_fields.label: Title
sub_fields.name: title
sub_fields.instructions: Keep it short — it is set very large. The first hero on a page is the page's H1.

sub_fields.label: Show logo art
sub_fields.name: show_mark
sub_fields.instructions: The black rounded logo tile on the right.

sub_fields.label: Anchor ID

sub_fields.instructions: Optional. Lets menus and buttons link here, e.g. "apps" for /#apps. Lowercase, no spaces.

sub_fields.label: Heading
sub_fields.name: heading
sub_fields.instructions: The page's main heading (h1) when this is the first module; leave empty to use the page title. Further down the page it's an h2.

sub_fields.label: Anchor ID
sub_fields.name: section_id
sub_fields.instructions: Optional. Lets menus and buttons link here, e.g. "apps" for /#apps. Lowercase, no spaces.

sub_fields.label: Featured app
sub_fields.name: featured_app
sub_fields.instructions: Shown as the large black card. Optional.

sub_fields.label: Suites
sub_fields.name: suites
sub_fields.instructions: Cards come from Apps (wp-admin → Apps). Choose which suites to show and in what order. A suite with no apps is hidden.

sub_fields.label: Anchor ID
sub_fields.name: section_id
sub_fields.instructions: Optional. Lets menus and buttons link here, e.g. "apps" for /#apps. Lowercase, no spaces.

sub_fields.label: Accent
sub_fields.name: accent_suite
sub_fields.instructions: Suite colour for the eyebrow rule and card hover line.

sub_fields.label: Columns

sub_fields.label: Icon
sub_fields.name: icon
sub_fields.instructions: An emoji, e.g. ✦ 🎵 ⚡. Optional.

sub_fields.label: Title
sub_fields.name: title
sub_fields.instructions: Optional.

sub_fields.label: Link
sub_fields.name: link
sub_fields.instructions: Optional. Makes the whole card clickable; the link text shows at the bottom of the card.

sub_fields.label: Apps
sub_fields.name: apps
sub_fields.instructions: Pick apps and drag to reorder. Leave empty to show all apps. On an app page, that app is left out.

sub_fields.label: Buttons
sub_fields.name: buttons

sub_fields.label: Anchor ID

sub_fields.instructions: Optional. Lets menus and buttons link here, e.g. "apps" for /#apps. Lowercase, no spaces.

sub_fields.label: Eyebrow
sub_fields.name: eyebrow
sub_fields.instructions: Shown before the app's status, e.g. "Spotlight · Demo available".

sub_fields.label: Heading
sub_fields.name: heading
sub_fields.instructions: Blank = app title.

sub_fields.label: Lead
sub_fields.name: lead
sub_fields.instructions: Blank = app tagline.

sub_fields.label: Show demo button
sub_fields.name: show_demo
sub_fields.instructions: Uses the app's demo link, if set.

sub_fields.label: Show Encore flow illustration
sub_fields.name: show_flow
sub_fields.instructions: Airtable → Publish → website animation. Encore only.

sub_fields.label: Anchor ID
sub_fields.name: section_id
sub_fields.instructions: Optional. Lets menus and buttons link here, e.g. "apps" for /#apps. Lowercase, no spaces.

sub_fields.label: Anchor ID
sub_fields.name: section_id
sub_fields.instructions: Optional. Lets menus and buttons link here, e.g. "apps" for /#apps. Lowercase, no spaces.

sub_fields.label: Image
sub_fields.name: image
sub_fields.instructions: At least 800px wide. Set the alt text in the Media Library.

sub_fields.label: Anchor ID
sub_fields.name: section_id
sub_fields.instructions: Optional. Lets menus and buttons link here, e.g. "apps" for /#apps. Lowercase, no spaces.

sub_fields.label: Image
sub_fields.name: image
sub_fields.instructions: At least 2400px wide for edge to edge. Set its alt text in the Media Library (ignored when overlay text is on).

sub_fields.label: Keep in view
sub_fields.name: focal_point
sub_fields.instructions: Which part of the image stays visible when cropped.

sub_fields.label: Caption
sub_fields.name: caption
sub_fields.instructions: Optional line under the image.

sub_fields.label: Overlay text
sub_fields.name: show_overlay
sub_fields.instructions: Heading, text and buttons on top of the image, on a dark gradient.

sub_fields.label: Darkening
sub_fields.name: overlay_strength
sub_fields.instructions: Go stronger if the text is hard to read on a bright photo.

sub_fields.label: Accent
sub_fields.name: accent_suite
sub_fields.instructions: Suite colour for the eyebrow rule and "Accent" buttons.

sub_fields.label: Buttons
sub_fields.name: buttons
sub_fields.instructions: Use "Black" or "Outline" — they turn white over the image — or "Accent".

sub_fields.label: Anchor ID
sub_fields.name: section_id
sub_fields.instructions: Optional. Lets menus and buttons link here, e.g. "apps" for /#apps. Lowercase, no spaces.

sub_fields.label: Accent
sub_fields.name: accent_suite
sub_fields.instructions: Suite colour for the play button and eyebrow rule.

sub_fields.label: YouTube or Vimeo link
sub_fields.name: video_url
sub_fields.instructions: Paste the normal page link, e.g. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=… or https://vimeo.com/…. The player only loads when someone clicks play.

sub_fields.label: Video file
sub_fields.name: video_file
sub_fields.instructions: MP4 (H.264) plays everywhere. Keep it small — under about 20 MB.

sub_fields.label: Poster image
sub_fields.name: poster
sub_fields.instructions: Shown before the video plays. Recommended for YouTube/Vimeo — without one the player is a black tile with a play button. 16:9, at least 1600px wide.

sub_fields.label: Video title
sub_fields.name: video_title
sub_fields.instructions: For screen readers ("Play video: …"). Blank = the heading.

sub_fields.label: Caption
sub_fields.name: caption
sub_fields.instructions: Optional line under the video.

sub_fields.label: Anchor ID
sub_fields.name: section_id
sub_fields.instructions: Optional. Lets menus and buttons link here, e.g. "apps" for /#apps. Lowercase, no spaces.

sub_fields.label: Accent
sub_fields.name: accent_suite
sub_fields.instructions: Suite colour for the feature ticks, badge and highlighted plan button.

sub_fields.label: Plans
sub_fields.name: plans
sub_fields.instructions: Two to four plans work best.

sub_fields.label: Price
sub_fields.name: price
sub_fields.instructions: Free text, e.g. £29, From £499, Free, POA.

sub_fields.label: Period
sub_fields.name: period
sub_fields.instructions: e.g. /month, per site, one-off.

sub_fields.label: Features
sub_fields.name: features
sub_fields.instructions: One feature per line.

sub_fields.label: Button
sub_fields.name: link
sub_fields.instructions: Optional.

sub_fields.label: Highlight this plan
sub_fields.name: featured
sub_fields.instructions: Shown as the black card with an accent button.

sub_fields.label: Badge
sub_fields.name: badge
sub_fields.instructions: e.g. "Most popular".

sub_fields.label: Small print
sub_fields.name: note
sub_fields.instructions: Optional line under the plans, e.g. "Prices exclude VAT."

sub_fields.label: Anchor ID
sub_fields.name: section_id
sub_fields.instructions: Optional. Lets menus and buttons link here, e.g. "apps" for /#apps. Lowercase, no spaces.

sub_fields.label: Accent
sub_fields.name: accent_suite
sub_fields.instructions: Suite colour for the eyebrow rule. Each member card uses its own suite colour.

sub_fields.label: Members
sub_fields.name: members
sub_fields.instructions: Pick people and drag to reorder. Leave empty to show everyone (wp-admin → Team, in Order).

sub_fields.label: Only this suite
sub_fields.name: only_suite
sub_fields.instructions: Optional. Shows only members tagged with this suite.

sub_fields.label: Columns
sub_fields.name: columns
sub_fields.instructions: Fewer columns on smaller screens.

sub_fields.name: section_id
sub_fields.instructions: Optional. Lets menus and buttons link here, e.g. "apps" for /#apps. Lowercase, no spaces.

sub_fields.label: Accent
sub_fields.name: accent_suite
sub_fields.instructions: Suite colour for the quote marks and eyebrow rule.

sub_fields.label: Testimonials
sub_fields.name: testimonials
sub_fields.instructions: Pick and drag to reorder. Leave empty to show all (wp-admin → Testimonials, in Order).

sub_fields.label: How many
sub_fields.name: limit
sub_fields.instructions: When showing all: the first N in order. Blank or 0 = all.

sub_fields.label: Columns
sub_fields.name: columns
sub_fields.instructions: Fewer columns on smaller screens.

sub_fields.label: Anchor ID
sub_fields.name: section_id
sub_fields.instructions: Optional. Lets menus and buttons link here, e.g. "apps" for /#apps. Lowercase, no spaces.

sub_fields.label: Add FAQ schema
sub_fields.name: output_schema
sub_fields.instructions: FAQPage structured data for Google. Use on one FAQ per page; turn off if an SEO plugin already adds it.

sub_fields.name: section_id
sub_fields.instructions: Optional. Lets menus and buttons link here, e.g. "apps" for /#apps. Lowercase, no spaces.

sub_fields.label: Accent

sub_fields.label: Contact form
sub_fields.message: The demo / enquiry form, anchored at #contact. Leave the fields blank to use the copy in Drift Settings → Contact. Use once per page.
